proof_basis: Each access retains a blocking mutex at address+delta on all CFG paths. On the same concrete non-TLS global, common byte congruence gcd(2^pointer_bits, coefficients) with widths <= period makes overlapping accesses have identical starts; equal delta then proves the same actual mutex. Fixed repeated sext/zext equality is used only within each activation.
scope: Direct Load/Store, local CFG, affine pointer coefficients, concrete non-TLS globals. Calls/rebindings/uncovered cycles/summary objects/unsupported index equivalences retain candidates.
limitations: Frozen full scan is ILP32; targeted regressions and reference runs cover both ABIs.
Existing ILP32 aggregate-copy importer crash on CASE10 persists before/after; LP64 is UNKNOWN. This case is recorded separately, not claimed passing.
